title: Multiple Variables
concept: You can declare many variables in a program, each holding different pieces of data.
why: Real programs handle many values at once — user info, settings, calculations. Learning to manage multiple variables is essential.
tips: Group related variables together with a blank line between groups
Use descriptive names: `days_in_week` is better than `d`
Variable names can't start with a number: `1st_place` is invalid
You can declare as many variables as you need
common_mistakes: Using the same variable name twice in the same scope
Using spaces in variable names — use underscores
Naming variables so cryptically that you forget what they mean
